paw_surface_segmentation.method: four connected low-surface components; source indices retained, lower-band/downward triangles are contact candidates, not pressure data

self_intersection.method: BVH overlap, exclude exact-position shared vertices, strict interior noncoplanar edge/triangle crossing
self_intersection.limits: Coplanar overlaps, tangencies, adjacent face folding and near seams not certified. Counts measure pairs, not defects; coordinate welding is diagnostic only.
